events.indication: relapsed/refractory peripheral T cell lymphoma and other T cell lymphomas
events.notes: Final Phase 1/1b data (200 mg BID cohort: median PFS 6.2 months, median OS 28.1 months) presented today in an oral session at the 67th ASH Annual Meeting & Exposition (Orlando, FL, Dec 6-9, 2025); release states explicitly 'today in an oral session'. Released 10:30 ET, during market hours, so the pre-event cutoff is the prior complete session (2025-12-05) per the DURING_MARKET_HOURS session rule.

New pooled IMerge analyses (oral presentation) and long-term follow-up data for RYTELO (imetelstat) presented same-day at ASH 2025 (Orlando, FL, Dec 6-9, 2025); release explicitly describes data 'presented at' the 2025 ASH Annual Meeting, dated the same calendar day as the conference session. Released 08:02 ET, pre-market, so the pre-event cutoff is the prior complete session (2025-12-05) per the PRE_MARKET session rule. RYTELO is Geron's approved commercial product; this is post-approval lifecycle/expanded-indication clinical data, not a pivotal or regulatory catalyst, so PHASE classification is flagged for promotion-time verification rather than assumed.
